description: A utility header file providing template functions for container operations such as erase, erase_if, set operations, and containment checks, primarily for standard library containers.

classes.name: HasKeyType
classes.description: A template class to detect if a collection type has a key_type member.

methods.name: IterateAndEraseIf
methods.description: Template function to erase elements from a container based on a predicate.

methods.name: ContainsKey
methods.description: Checks if a collection contains a specific key.

methods.name: ContainsValue
methods.description: Checks if a collection contains a specific value, disabled for collections with key_type.

methods.name: STLIsSorted
methods.description: Checks if a container is sorted.

methods.name: STLSetDifference
methods.description: Returns the difference of two sorted containers.

methods.name: STLSetUnion
methods.description: Returns the union of two sorted containers.

methods.name: STLSetIntersection
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two sorted containers.

methods.name: STLIncludes
methods.description: Checks if one sorted container includes all elements of another.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Removes elements matching a value from various container types.

methods.name: EraseIf
methods.description: Removes elements satisfying a predicate from various container types.
